issues.legal_issue: An emergency acquisition notification cannot dispense with the landowner’s right to object when it fails to state the required land qualification and the government’s opinion that immediate possession is urgent.
material_facts: A land-acquisition notification directed that emergency powers be used and that the objection procedure be dispensed with.
The notification did not state that the land was waste or arable, or that the government was of the opinion that there was urgency to take immediate possession.
The notification merely directed the Collector to act under the emergency power on grounds of urgency.
issues.conclusion: The direction dispensing with the objection procedure was invalid; the Court struck down that portion of the notification and allowed the appeal and writ petition.
issues.legal_principle: Under Sections 17(1) and 17(4) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, the government may dispense with the objection procedure only where the land is waste or arable and urgency requires immediate possession. The landowner’s right to object under Section 5A must not be interfered with casually or cavalierly. A direction to the Collector to take action on grounds of urgency does not by itself fulfill the legal requirements. No earlier cases are cited.

rule.if: emergency_acquisition_case and objection_opportunity_dispensed and notification_omits_land_qualification and notification_omits_government_urgency_opinion and collector_only_directed_on_urgency

predicates.emergency_acquisition_case: The proceeding concerns acquisition of land using an emergency power to obtain possession.
predicates.objection_opportunity_dispensed: The government’s notification removes the landowner’s opportunity to file an objection.
predicates.notification_omits_land_qualification: The notification does not state that the land is waste or arable.
predicates.notification_omits_government_urgency_op: The notification does not state that the government is of the opinion that urgency requires immediate possession.
predicates.collector_only_directed_on_urgency: The notification merely directs the Collector to act on grounds of urgency.

issues.definition: When an emergency land-acquisition proceeding dispenses with objections and the notification omits both the land qualification and the government’s urgency opinion, while merely directing the Collector to act on urgency, the dispensation is invalid.
